                    REPLY BRIEF OF SF EASTSIDE INVESTMENTS LLC AND
                                CRAWFORD PARTNERS, LP

TO THE HONORABLE ADMINISTRATIVE LAW JUDGES:
           Matt Mathias, Manager of SF Eastside Investments, LLC ("SF Eastside"), and Thomas
Crawford, Partner of Crawford Partners, LP ("Crawford Partners"), intervenors in the above-
captioned proceeding (collectively, the "Intervenors"), file this Reply Brief in response to the
Initial Briefs submitted by the Joint Applicants, Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC and LCRA
Transmission Services Corporation ("Applicants"), and Commission Staff, and in support thereof
respectfully state as follows:


                        I.      RESPONSE TO APPLICANTS' INITIAL BRIEF
           In Applicants’ Initial Brief 1, Applicants continue to recommend Route 894 as the route that
best satisfies the applicable routing criteria under PURA § 37.056 and 16 TAC § 25.101. Applicants
explain that Route 894 best balances the applicable routing factors, including cost, route length,
habitable structures, paralleling, parks, river crossings, and cultural resources, when considered
collectively rather than individually. Applicants further recognize that route selection requires a



1
    Applicants’ Initial Brief, ﬁled June 19, 2026, Interchange Item No. 6311



                                                      Page 1 of 3
 reasoned balancing of all applicable routing criteria and acknowledge that the Commission
ultimately retains the authority to select any viable route presented in the Application.
           The Intervenors have reviewed Applicants' discussion of Route 894 and have no objection
to the Commission selecting that route.


                   II.     RESPONSE TO COMMISSION STAFF'S INITIAL BRIEF
           In Staff’s Initial Brief 2, Commission Staff recommends approval of Route 487 after
evaluating the routing criteria contained in PURA § 37.056(c) and 16 TAC § 25.101(b)(3)(B). Staff
concludes that Route 487 appropriately balances the applicable statutory routing considera,
including community values, environmental integrity, engineering constraints, cost, prudent
avoidance, and impacts to affected landowners. Staff likewise concludes that Route 487 represents
the route that best satisfies the governing routing criteria and recommends that the Administrative
Law Judges adopt Route 487 in the Proposal for Decision.
           The Intervenors have reviewed Staff's recommendation and likewise have no objection to
the Commission approving Route 487.


                                           III.     CONCLUSION
           The Intervenors participated in this proceeding for the limited purpose of opposing routing
alternatives that would utilize Segment Link U1 across their respective properties. Because neither
Applicants' preferred Route 894 nor Commission Staff's recommended Route 487 utilizes the
routing alternative opposed by the Intervenors, the Intervenors respectfully state that they do not
oppose either recommendation.
           Accordingly, the Intervenors respectfully request that the Administrative Law Judges
consider this Reply Brief in preparing the Proposal for Decision and note that SF Eastside
Investments LLC and Crawford Partners, LP are unopposed to the selection of either Applicants'
preferred Route 894 or Commission Staff's recommended Route 487.
